technology_name: P-16 — 940nm NIR through scalp/skull to implanted GaAs PV cell. Verified fluence 1.0-1.
one_line_proposition: Technology: 940nm NIR through scalp/skull to implanted GaAs PV cell. Verified fluence 1.0-1.4 mW/cm² (~1000-1400 μW).. Problem: Transcranial power for implanted devices. Current solution (inductive coupling) is alignment-critical and depth-limited..
target_application: Transcranial power for implanted devices. Current solution (inductive coupling) is alignment-critical and depth-limited.
why_you_may_care: A computationally externally verified P-16 technology with physical validation still outstanding.

current_evidence.evidence_summary: See evidence ledger — 4 evidence atoms across 6 tiers

what_is_not_proven: R308 diffusion approximation (744 μW) was conservative — verified is higher
decisive_question: Actual 940nm tissue transmission in shunt patients. PV cell efficiency in vivo.
if_pass: Advance to next development phase (see Development Plan)
what_we_are_asking_you_to_do: LICENSE — pip install pytissueoptics, run script (get ~1.4 mW/cm²), then bench: LED + phantom + PV
